definitions.explanation: An event where companies display and demonstrate their products and services to potential business customers, typically held at a convention center.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見本市|みほんいち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出展|しゅってん}→出展：11986_shutten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will exhibit at next week's trade fair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{見本市|みほんいち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: Many companies participate in the international trade show.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧{見本市|みほんいち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧デモンストレーション⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行う：01238_okonau⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: We demonstrated our new products at a trade fair held in Tokyo and received many orders.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{見本|みほん}→見本：00279_mihon⟧ (sample) + ⟦{市|いち}→市：10013_ichi⟧ (market). Literally a "sample market" where goods are displayed for potential buyers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{見本市|みほんいち} (international trade fair)
- {見本市|みほんいち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出展|しゅってん}→出展：11986_shutten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exhibit at a trade fair)
- {見本市|みほんいち}⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧ (trade fair venue)

USAGE:
The English loanword ⟦{展示会|てんじかい}→展示会：21869_tenjikai⟧ is also used, though {見本市|みほんいち} emphasizes the commercial, business-to-business nature of the event.
